newsitem.title: USA: Synthetic Industries Inc Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Synthetic Industries Inc Q3 net rises.

text.p: (In thousands, except share and per share amounts)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended

NOTE: (1) Pro forma results reflect the reduction in interest expense after giving effect to the $34 million of net proceeds from the Company's IPO in November 1996 and the refinancing of its 12 3/4% Senior Subordinated Debentures with the proceeds from the sale of its 9 1/4% Senior Subordinated Notes in February 1997 and assumes such transactions occurred at the beginning of fiscal 1996. Pro forma results do not include the extraordinary charge of $11,950 ($1.39 per share) resulting from the bond refinancing.

Actual net income per share was $0.86 for the three months ended June 30, 1997 and June 30, 1996. Actual income per share before extraordinary item was $1.25 and $0.47 for the nine months ended June 30, 1997 and June 30, 1996. Actual net income (loss) per share was ($0.14) and $0.47 for the nine months ended June 30, 1997 and June 30, 1996. There were approximately 51% and 45% more weighted average shares outstanding in the most recent third quarter and nine month period, respectively, reflecting the Company's IPO (8,969,031 and 8,598,959 for the three and nine months ending June 30, 1997, respectively and 5,930,502 for the comparable periods of fiscal 1996).
